what.title: What is a destination tag or memo?
what.description: A destination tag or memo is a unique identifier that helps ensure a cryptocurrency deposit is credited to the correct recipient. It's usually required when sending funds to services or exchanges that use shared wallet addresses.

why.title: Why do I need one?
why.description: The destination token is identified as requiring additional identifying information in order to be properly delivered. Please make sure you provide this additional information to guarantee a successful swap.

where.title: Where can I find my destination tag/memo?
where.description: It is typically a unique identifying string that can be found in your recipient account information.

neo3NeoXBridgeInfo.title: How does it work?
neo3NeoXBridgeInfo.description1: Easily bridge your crypto assets between networks, without ever leaving your wallet.
neo3NeoXBridgeInfo.description2: Blockchains are independent of each other, and can’t interact with each other - That's where bridges come in. It’s similar in principle to exchanging money while traveling to different countries, a bridge allows you to transfer assets across various blockchains.
neo3NeoXBridgeInfo.description3: Directly and immediately bridging tokens in NEON is convenient and allows you to save time and pay lower fees.
neo3NeoXBridgeInfo.alert: COZ are not maintainers of this bridging process - Neo Global Development is the maintainer.
